description: 外部验证 closure evidence summary 契约。该摘要消费 work queue、proof-ref gate、category runbooks、operator execution packet、live proof gate 和 closure trend dashboard，输出按 domain/category/owner 聚合的外部验证关闭状态、缺失证据、operator step、凭证名称和审计可读 next action。它不执行外部请求，不保存真实凭证或 endpoint，不把 pending summary 伪装成 live passed。

closurePolicy.passed: Only when every work item has accepted proof-ref and accepted live proof.
closurePolicy.blocked: Any missing proof-ref, missing live proof, stale alert, manual triage or policy guardrail keeps closure blocked.
closurePolicy.evidenceSource: This summary is an index of existing local gate artifacts; it does not create proof refs or live proofs.

privacyBoundary: Closure evidence summary 只保存 category、domain、owner、workItemId、occurrence count、required credential 名称、operator step id、proof-ref/live 状态、阻断原因和 source hash；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、chat id、外部账号、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文或用户输入。
nonClaims: Does not execute external live checks.
Does not create proof refs or live proofs.
Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
